Alyssa: quick sync — we need final signoff on the catalog pipeline & SI integration playbook. aiming for press window in early apr, want to lock landing page microcopy and partner hero assets today :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mike: ok — can you paste the exact press window you mentioned? planning calendar on my side now
Alyssa: target week of Apr 6–12, embargo Tue Apr 7 09:00 PT. if that slips we push to next week. pressops, is that doable?
PressOpsBot: PressOps checklist created: https://internal.redwood/press/checks/2113 — embargo slot saved (provisional). please upload final quotes by EOD Fri.
Sara: landing page owners are me + DevEx. i can take hero copy + partner logos, need final art from Partner-Eng by 4pm PT.
Partner-Eng: sending consolidated assets in 2 PRs. small ask — hardware partners provided SKU mapping and perf badges; need confirmation that we can publish the perf badges without additional QC.
Mike: who signs off on perf badges? Legal or Applied ML needs to sign off on numbers.
Jordan: Applied ML here — we need the `p50/p95 latency` and `tokens/sec` for the SKU matrix. give us raw run IDs, i'll sanity check and stamp.
Partner-Eng: run IDs: `r-2026-03-18-39`, `r-2026-03-19-07`. badges draft attached to PR #412.
DevEx: small copy note — on the signup CTA we should say "Reserved capacity available" not "Dedicated" to match product wording. also add short tooltip for "SLA-backed latency" to avoid overpromise.
Alyssa: good catch, DevEx. make that update and paste snippet here so PressOps can reuse.
DevEx: snippet: "Reserve dedicated capacity with configurable autoscaling and SLA-backed latency targets." use as hero subhead.
PressOpsBot: noted. creating draft embargo email for partners and press list. will ping legal for the quotes.
Mike: legal review ETA?
Sara: legal says 24–36h for quote wording, quicker if we limit numbers to rounded aggregates.
Jordan: i can mirror-check and reduce to aggregates: p50 latency ~20ms, p95 ~85ms, tokens/sec ~1200 for the tested SKU. ok to round to 20ms / 85ms / 1.2k t/s?
Legal (via PressOpsBot): approval pending — please include model/test spec appendix and link to evals dashboard.
Alyssa: action items final: Partner-Eng upload final art + badge PR, Jordan finalize rounded perf numbers, DevEx update CTA copy, Sara assemble landing copy + images, PressOps finalize embargo email + press kit, Legal to sign quotes.
Mike: who is on call for last-minute deploy issues during embargo? Deploy-Bot, schedule?
Deploy-Bot: Canary window recommended 1hr before embargo, on-call: eng-oncall rotation A. will post runbook to channel 30m prior.
Partner-Eng: one more dependency — SI integration docs (auth flows + sample terraform) need a small README. i'll drop a skeleton into `partners/docs/si-onboarding.md` by 16:00 PT.
Alyssa: excellent. if everyone hits their deadlines we keep Apr 7. if legal or assets slip we slide a week. i'll track in the checklist and post final status at 18:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
Mike: thanks — will follow up on calendar invites and slack reminders.
Sara: i'll queue the page for preview and send the staging URL when ready. :rocket:
Alyssa: perfect — wrapping up. ping me if blockers pop.
